title: Eight Hallmarks for Governing Artificial Intelligence in Medical Affairs: A Structured Pathway for Responsible AI Adoption
Transformaciones en los discursos sobre la educación superior: análisis documental de los proyectos de reforma de la Ley de Educación Superior argentina
abstractText: La Ley de Educación Superior (LES 24.521) constituyó un punto de inflexión en la regulación del sistema universitario argentino, generando consensos y resistencias que persistieron hasta la actualidad. El presente trabajo analiza comparativamente los principales proyectos de reforma de la LES presentados en Argentina, con especial atención al proyecto de Ley de Libertad Educativa impulsado por el Poder Ejecutivo Nacional actual. A partir de un análisis documental, se relevaron proyectos legislativos, normativa vigente y resoluciones ministeriales, identificando continuidades, rupturas y desplazamientos discursivos en torno a la autonomía, la evaluación, el financiamiento, la calidad y la inclusión universitaria. De esta forma, se reconstruyen las concepciones de universidad, Estado y regulación que subyacen a cada propuesta, abordando los proyectos legislativos como producciones discursivas que expresan distintos modelos de gobernanza universitaria.

title: A review of phase-change display: materials, architectures, driving, and applications
PENGEMBANGAN DAN KARAKTERISASI BERAS ANALOG BERBASIS EKSTRAK PHYSALIS ANGULATA BERDASARKAN AKTIVITAS ANTIOKSIDAN DAN KOMPOSISI PROKSIMAT
abstractText: This study aims to develop and characterize a functional food product in the form of an antioxidant-rich analog rice for individuals with type 2 diabetes mellitus. The formulation utilizes local food commodities comprising modified cassava flour (mocaf), purple sweet potato flour, rice bran, and seaweed combined with ciplukan (Physalis angulata L.) extract as a source of natural antioxidants. The research procedures involved maceration extraction of ciplukan, analog rice extrusion, antioxidant activity evaluation using the DPPH (2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl) assay, and proximate composition analysis. Laboratory data were analyzed using quantitative descriptive statistics, calculating mean values, standard deviations, relative percent difference (RPD), and linear regression analysis to determine the 50% inhibitory concentration (IC_50). The results revealed that ciplukan extract exhibited very strong antioxidant activity, with an average IC_50 value of 5.66 mg/L and an RPD precision of 4.4%. Proximate analysis of the analog rice yielded a moisture content of 3.24%, ash content of 7.31%, protein 4.62%, fat 11.32%, and carbohydrates 73.51%. Based on the acquired antioxidant properties and chemical composition, this analog rice demonstrates high potential as an alternative functional staple food to support blood glucose management. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini bertujuan mengembangkan dan mengkarakterisasi produk pangan fungsional berbentuk beras analog kaya antioksidan bagi penyandang diabetes melitus tipe 2. Formulasi produk memanfaatkan bahan pangan lokal berupa tepung modified cassava flour (mocaf), tepung ubi jalar ungu, bekatul, dan rumput laut dengan penambahan ekstrak ciplukan (Physalis angulata L.) sebagai sumber antioksidan alami. Tahapan kerja mencakup ekstraksi maserasi simplisia ciplukan, pencetakan beras analog, pengujian aktivitas antioksidan dengan metode DPPH (2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl), serta pengujian komposisi proksimat. Data hasil uji laboratorium dianalisis secara statistik deskriptif kuantitatif menggunakan pengukuran nilai rata-rata, simpangan baku, relative percent difference (RPD), dan analisis regresi linear untuk penentuan nilai konsentrasi penghambatan 50% (IC_50). Hasil pengujian menunjukkan ekstrak ciplukan memiliki aktivitas antioksidan sangat kuat dengan rata-rata nilai IC_50 sebesar 5,66 mg/L dan presisi RPD sebesar 4,4%. Analisis proksimat produk beras analog menghasilkan kadar air 3,24%, kadar abu 7,31%, protein 4,62%, lemak 11,32%, dan karbohidrat 73,51%. Berdasarkan profil antioksidan dan komposisi kimia yang diperoleh, beras analog ini berpotensi menjadi alternatif pangan pokok fungsional untuk mendukung kestabilan kadar glukosa darah.

title: Molecular and immune heterogeneity across limited-stage and extensive-stage small cell lung cancer
abstractText: Abstract Immune checkpoint inhibitors are now standard care for small-cell lung cancer (SCLC); however, a profound prognostic disparity persists between limited-stage (LS) and extensive-stage (ES) disease. Although clinical staging defines tumor spread, the specific molecular characteristics distinguishing LS from ES remain poorly understood, despite their potential link to immunotherapy responsiveness. To investigate this, we profiled transcriptomes of 361 patients with histologically confirmed SCLC (100 LS-SCLC and 261 ES-SCLC). Analysis identified distinct stage-specific features: LS tumors exhibit enriched immune signatures, notably B cell-receptor signaling, whereas ES tumors are defined by upregulated MYC targets and oxidative phosphorylation. A derived ‘pseudostage rank’ captured this transcriptomic continuum, effectively stratifying patients. Notably, patients with high rank ES showed significantly worse survival with chemoimmunotherapy (median difference: 5.8 months, P < 0.05), a distinction absent in chemotherapy-only cohorts. These findings suggest that the molecular transition from LS to ES involves metabolic reprogramming and immune evasion. Consequently, these molecular subtypes and pseudostage ranking offer novel biomarkers for therapeutic stratification, moving beyond conventional clinical staging.

title: PENGEMBANGAN PERBAN CAIR BERBASIS EKSTRAK RUMPUT BELULANG (ELEUSINE INDICA) SEBAGAI SEDIAAN PERAWATAN LUKA BERBASIS BAHAN ALAM
abstractText: Superficial skin wounds require effective physical protection to minimize environmental contamination while maintaining a balanced microenvironment for tissue repair. A liquid bandage represents a practical modern topical formulation capable of forming a transparent, flexible barrier that conforms to anatomical skin contours. This study aimed to formulate EleuSeal, a novel liquid bandage incorporating goosegrass (Eleusine indica) extract, and evaluate its total phenolic content, antioxidant capacity, and physicochemical properties. The experimental procedures included ethanolic maceration, Folin–Ciocalteu total phenolic assay, 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH) radical scavenging evaluation, and physical characterization performed in triplicate (n = 3). The results demonstrated a total phenolic content of 10.20 ± 0.35 mg GAE/g extract and significant antioxidant activity with an 〖"IC" 〗_50 value of 1.57 ± 0.04 mg/mL (R^2=0.998). The optimized EleuSeal formulation exhibited a skin-compatible pH of 5.02 ± 0.08, a rapid drying time of 98.67 ± 4.16 seconds, excellent film flexibility without cracking, low surface tackiness, and balanced water washability. These findings demonstrate that EleuSeal holds promising potential as a functional bio-based liquid dressing for superficial abrasions, although future in vivo safety and wound closure assays remain essential. ABSTRAK Luka kulit superfisial membutuhkan perlindungan fisik yang efektif untuk meminimalkan paparan kontaminan lingkungan serta menjaga kelembapan mikro guna mendukung regenerasi sel. Perban cair (liquid bandage) merupakan alternatif sediaan topikal modern yang aplikatif karena mampu membentuk lapisan film transparan dan fleksibel mengikuti kontur kulit. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk memformulasi sediaan perban cair EleuSeal berbasis ekstrak rumput belulang (Eleusine indica) serta mengevaluasi kandungan fenolik total, aktivitas antioksidan, dan sifat fisiknya. Pengujian dilakukan melalui ekstraksi maserasi dengan pelarut etanol, penetapan kadar fenolik total (Folin–Ciocalteu), pengujian aktivitas antioksidan (DPPH assay), dan evaluasi fisik sediaan yang diulang sebanyak tiga kali (triplo). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan ekstrak rumput belulang mengandung fenolik total sebesar 10,20 ± 0,35 mg GAE/g dan aktivitas penangkapan radikal bebas dengan nilai 〖"IC" 〗_50 sebesar 1,57 ± 0,04 mg/mL (R^2=0,998). Formulasi EleuSeal menghasilkan sediaan dengan pH fisiologis 5,02 ± 0,08, waktu pengeringan cepat selama 98,67 ± 4,16 detik, lapisan film yang fleksibel tanpa retak, daya lekat rendah, serta sifat kemudahan pencucian yang seimbang. Karakteristik ini membuktikan bahwa EleuSeal memiliki potensi aplikatif yang baik sebagai sediaan perban cair pelindung luka ringan, meskipun pengujian biokompatibilitas dan efikasi penyembuhan luka secara in vivo tetap diperlukan pada penelitian lanjutan.

title: On global reconstruction in generalized Rastall gravity and the invertibility of the Ricci scalar.
abstractText: Abstract For the static and spherically symmetric case, we study the global consistency of the inverse reconstruction of generalized Rastall theory, G αβ +λH(R)g αβ = κ T αβ , when the geometry is fixed before the generalized Rastall function H(R). The analysis addresses the existence of a global inverse r=r(R) and the compatibility among the different radial branches when several radii produce the same value of the Ricci scalar curvature R. To illustrate the relevance of the analysis, we consider the regular Fan--Wang family with vanishing independent Schwarzschild mass. It is shown that R(r) is globally invertible if and only if μ=3 and 0<ν ≦ 1. The case ν=1 admits the elementary inverse r(R)=(24M F q 2 /R) 1/5 -q, whereas for 0<ν<1 the inverse is unique even though, in general, it cannot be expressed explicitly. It is also shown that the Hayward geometry employed by Lin and Qian and identified by (μ,ν)=(3,3) possesses two physical inverses over R min < R<0; the functions reconstructed on the two branches differ for ω ≦ 1/3, so the reconstruction is multivalued. For ω ≠ -1,1/3, a global single-valued function H(R) exists throughout the regular Fan--Wang family if and only if μ=3 and 0<ν ≦ 1. In this sector, H ∈ C 1 \ C 2 for 0<ν<1 and H ∈ C 0 \ C 1 for ν=1.

title: INTEGRASI GENERATIVE VIDEO DALAM WORKFLOW PRODUKSI VFX FILM PENDEK “SPLIT//SECOND”
abstractText: The rapid advancement of generative video technology presents novel opportunities for visual effects (VFX) asset generation, yet full reliance on artificial intelligence often creates visual inconsistencies, reduced artistic control, and integration barriers with live-action footage. This article aims to analyze the integration of generative video into the VFX post-production workflow of the short film “SPLIT//SECOND” and evaluate its effectiveness relative to conventional computer-generated imagery (CGI) practices. Employing a practice-based research methodology, the production applied a hybrid workflow where live-action footage serves as the physical reality anchor while artificial intelligence assets construct surreal virtual reality (VR) elements. Empirical results demonstrate that generative video substantially accelerates visual asset acquisition with up to 95% time efficiency, reducing manual tasks from 60–90 minutes to approximately 30 seconds to 3 minutes. Although it eliminates manual modeling labor, this method does not remove the essential requirements of digital compositing, rotoscoping, tracking, and color matching, while also introducing variable operating costs driven by platform credit consumption. ABSTRAK Perkembangan teknologi generative video membuka peluang baru dalam penyediaan aset visual effects (VFX), namun penggunaannya secara mandiri kerap memicu kendala konsistensi visual, penurunan kontrol artistik, dan hambatan integrasi dengan rekaman live-action. Artikel ini bertujuan menganalisis integrasi generative video dalam workflow produksi VFX pada film pendek “SPLIT//SECOND” serta membandingkan efektivitasnya dengan pendekatan computer-generated imagery (CGI) konvensional. Penciptaan karya menerapkan metode practice-based research melalui hybrid workflow yang menempatkan rekaman live-action sebagai jangkar realitas fisik dan elemen berbasis kecerdasan buatan (artificial intelligence / AI) sebagai pembangun dunia virtual reality (VR). Pengujian empiris membuktikan bahwa pemanfaatan generative video mampu mempercepat penyediaan aset visual secara signifikan dengan efisiensi waktu mencapai 95%, yakni dari durasi manual sekitar 60–90 menit menjadi hanya 30 detik hingga 3 menit. Kendati memangkas tahapan teknis permodelan manual, pendekatan ini tidak mengeliminasi kebutuhan digital compositing, rotoscoping, tracking, dan color matching, serta menimbulkan konsekuensi beban biaya variabel berbasis konsumsi credits.

title: Hotspot issues and considerations in multi-gene testing in breast cancer
abstractText: Abstract Multigene testing serves as a cornerstone of precision oncology, reshaping the holistic management of breast cancer across its continuum. In early-stage HR-positive/HER2-negative (HR+/HER2-) disease, genomic assays such as MammaPrint ® and Oncotype DX ® enable refined risk stratification; however, their evidence bases diverge significantly when extrapolated to node-positive (1–3 LN+) populations, where only MammaPrint ® currently meets the threshold for guiding chemotherapy de-escalation. For premenopausal patients, age acts as an effect modifier, necessitating the integration of genomic risk with clinical and ovarian function suppression considerations. Beyond adjuvant decisions, these assays also inform extended endocrine therapy duration and anthracycline-sparing strategies, albeit with varying levels of evidence. In advanced disease, dynamic monitoring of resistance driver genes—particularly ESR1 and PIK3CA via circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)—is critical for overcoming endocrine resistance and tailoring targeted therapies. Notably, ctDNA analysis facilitates the detection of “molecular recurrence” prior to radiological progression, shifting surveillance toward preemptive intervention. Liquid biopsy further provides risk stratification and treatment response evaluation in both early and advanced settings. Despite persistent challenges regarding cross-platform discordance and standardization, multigene testing epitomizes the integration of molecular insights with clinical practice. Ongoing research and health-economic evaluations, particularly within the Chinese healthcare context, promise to refine these strategies toward truly individualized care.

title: Factors associated with awareness and attitudes toward childbirth methods among pregnant women: a structural equation modeling study
PEMBELAJARAN BERDIFERENSIASI DALAM MENINGKATKAN AKTIVITAS DAN HASIL BELAJAR SISWA SMA NEGERI 1 MUARA BADAK
abstractText: Differentiated instruction represents a pedagogical framework designed to accommodate students' diverse learning profiles, readiness levels, and personal interests in secondary education. This study aims to analyze the implementation of differentiated instruction in Pancasila and Civic Education (PPKn) and to describe the observed tendencies in students' learning activities and conceptual learning outcomes at SMA Negeri 1 Muara Badak. A descriptive qualitative design was employed, utilizing in-depth semi-structured interviews, non-participant classroom observations evaluated on a 1–4 rating scale, and instructional documentation. Informants were selected through purposive sampling, consisting of the school principal, the civic education teacher, and student representatives to ensure multi-perspective data triangulation. The findings reveal that the teacher consistently implemented all instructional differentiation components with a score of 4, comprising diagnostic assessments, flexible grouping, and systematic differentiation of content, process, and product. Regarding learning activities, collaborative, communicative, and participatory behaviors performed optimally with a score of 4, whereas learner autonomy and task completion scored 3 due to the continuous need for instructional scaffolding. Furthermore, observed learning outcomes indicated positive conceptual understanding tendencies without asserting causal gains due to the qualitative nature of the research. ABSTRAK Pembelajaran berdiferensiasi merupakan pendekatan pedagogis yang dirancang untuk merespons keberagaman profil belajar, kesiapan, dan minat siswa pada jenjang sekolah menengah. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis penerapan pembelajaran berdiferensiasi pada mata pelajaran Pendidikan Pancasila dan Kewarganegaraan (PPKn) serta mendeskripsikan kecenderungan kualitas aktivitas dan hasil belajar siswa di SMA Negeri 1 Muara Badak. Pendekatan yang digunakan adalah kualitatif deskriptif dengan teknik pengumpulan data melalui wawancara mendalam, observasi partisipatif menggunakan skala peringkat 1–4, dan studi dokumentasi. Informan dipilih secara purposif yang mencakup kepala sekolah, guru PPKn, dan perwakilan siswa guna mencapai triangulasi data multi-perspektif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa guru menerapkan seluruh tahapan diferensiasi secara konsisten dengan skor 4, mencakup asesmen diagnostik, pengelompokan fleksibel, serta diferensiasi konten, proses, dan produk. Pada dimensi aktivitas belajar, aspek komunikasi, kerja sama, dan partisipasi teramati sangat optimal dengan skor 4, sedangkan kemandirian dan penyelesaian tugas memperoleh skor 3 karena siswa masih memerlukan bimbingan bertahap (scaffolding). Sementara itu, indikator hasil belajar menunjukkan kecenderungan pemahaman konseptual yang positif tanpa adanya klaim peningkatan kausal akibat keterbatasan desain kualitatif.

title: The Application of the Inquiry Learning Model to Enhance Critical Thinking Skills in Science and Social Studies (IPAS) Instruction for Grade III Students at SD Negeri 3 Kota Mobagu
abstractText: This classroom action research aimed to improve students' critical thinking skills through the Inquiry Learning model in Natural and Social Sciences (IPAS) lessons on heat energy sources in Grade III at SD Negeri 3 Kotamobagu. The study was conducted in two cycles with 29 students, each cycle consisting of planning, action, observation, and reflection. Data were collected through an essay test based on five of Ennis' critical thinking indicators (Focus, Reason, Inference, Situation, Clarity) and through observation of teacher and student activities. In Cycle I, the mean critical thinking score was 58.10, with classical mastery (minimum category Good, score ≥ 60) of 51.72%; student activity was 66.25% and teacher activity was 71.43%, both in the Good category. After improvements in Cycle II, namely stronger teacher guidance, guiding questions, and greater student involvement in inquiry activities, the mean score rose to 77.76 with classical mastery of 93.10%; student activity increased to 88.75% and teacher activity to 91.96%, both in the Very Good category. Based on the school's learning objective achievement criterion (score ≥ 75), classical mastery rose from 24.14% to 72.41%, which is still below the 75% target. These results indicate an improvement in students' critical thinking after the implementation of the Inquiry Learning model.

title: The Epistemological Function of Mantiq (Logic) in Al-Ghazali’s Mi‘yar al-‘Ilm
abstractText: Although Al-Ghazali’s epistemology and logical thought have been widely examined, the role of mantiq (logic) in knowledge formation and validation in Mi‘yar al-‘Ilm fi Fann al-Mantiq remains insufficiently explored. This study analyzes the epistemological function of logic in Al-Ghazali’s thought through a philosophical examination of this work. A qualitative library research approach was employed, using Mi‘yar al-‘Ilm as the primary source alongside secondary literature on Al-Ghazali’s logic, Islamic epistemology, and the development of mantiq within the Islamic intellectual tradition. Sources were documented and analyzed using descriptive-analytical and interpretive methods, focusing on tashawwur, tashdiq, definitions, propositions, and qiyas. The findings indicate that logic functions as an epistemological instrument that structures knowledge acquisition through accurate conceptualization, proper judgment, and valid inference. However, logic is not presented as the sole source of knowledge, since the epistemic warrant of its conclusions also depends on the truth and justification of the premises. These findings clarify the relationship between logical reasoning and knowledge validation in Al-Ghazali’s epistemological framework. The study contributes to understanding mantiq as a methodological foundation that connects rational inquiry with the broader pursuit of knowledge within the Islamic intellectual tradition.

title: All-optical 2D perovskite photodetector arrays for pixelated long-wave infrared imaging
abstractText: Abstract Infrared detection and imaging are important for applications including thermal monitoring, night vision, environmental sensing, and molecular identification. All-optical mid-wave infrared (MWIR) and long-wave infrared (LWIR) detection offers a compelling alternative to conventional infrared detectors by enabling non-contact photothermal sensing without needing electronic readout circuitry. Here, we demonstrate pixelated LWIR imaging using solution-processed two-dimensional metal-halide perovskites (2D-MHPs), whose strong electron-phonon interaction produces a large temperature coefficient of reflectance in the visible wavelength range. By integrating (PEA) 2 PbI 4 films with LWIR-absorbing SiNₓ membranes, we realize centimeter-scale imagers capable of detecting 9.5-µm LWIR light with sensitivity down to ~20 pW·µm⁻². To mitigate lateral thermal diffusion that limits spatial fidelity, we introduce a structured-probe illumination scheme, and we further develop a fully pixelated imager with thermally isolated membrane-disc arrays. This design effectively eliminates pixel-to-pixel crosstalk and enables high-resolution optical readout using a silicon-based CMOS camera. These advances establish 2D-MHP-based all-optical thermal imaging as a scalable, low-cost platform for LWIR sensing, with strong potential for extension to far-infrared and terahertz detection.

title: Hylocereus undatus peel extract and ZnO nanoparticles suppress cancer through apoptosis and Wnt/β-catenin inhibition
abstractText: Abstract Cancer treatment faces the challenge of multidrug resistance and systemic cytotoxicity. This study explores the anticancer potential of Hylocereus undatus peel extracts and their biogenically synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs). Total phenolics, flavonoids and GC–MS profiles of the extracts were determined. Then, ZnO NPs were synthesized by using aqueous and n-hexane extracts and characterized by FTIR, Zeta Potential, XRD, SEM, EDX, and TEM. Among all tested formulations, ZnO NPs-AE (derived from the aqueous extract) showed the strongest antitumor activity, both in cell culture (Caco‑2 and HepG2) and in the Ehrlich ascites carcinoma mouse model. In MTT assays, ZnO NPs-AE was highly cytotoxic to Caco‑2 and HepG2 cells (IC₅₀ = 9.22 and 12.93 µg/mL, respectively) and performed on the same level as doxorubicin ( p < 0.05). It also showed a more favourable selectivity profile, being less toxic to normal colon fibroblasts (CCD‑18Co; IC₅₀ = 32.35 µg/mL) than to Caco‑2 cells (IC₅₀ = 9.22 µg/mL), which was better than doxorubicin. Consistent with this, ZnO NPs-AE reduced the proportion of cells in G2/M phase (7.39% compared with 12.65% in untreated cells) and increased total apoptosis to 25.98% in Caco‑2 cells. Molecularly, it up-regulated caspase-3 (6.15-fold), down-regulated topoisomerase II (0.33-fold) and suppressed the Wnt/β catenin axis. Consistently, ELISA quantification of Axin2 and Cyclin D1 in Caco‑2 cells confirmed down‑regulation of these Wnt/β‑catenin targets in parallel with the decrease in β‑catenin protein. In vivo, ZnO NPs-AE (5 mg/kg) reduced EAC volume to 89.36%, normalized hepatic/renal biomarkers, improved lipid profiles, and alleviated oxidative stress by elevating GSH, CAT, and SOD levels, while reducing MDA, alongside histopathological improvements. Overall, ZnO NPs-AE represents a promising, well tolerated biogenic nanoplatform for targeted cancer therapy.

title: Treatment outcomes and influencing factors of older patients with pulmonary tuberculosis complicated with diabetes mellitus in China, 2018–2024
abstractText: Abstract Background The comorbidity of pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) and diabetes mellitus (DM) is rising among adults aged ≥ 65 years in China. DM comorbidity significantly worsens PTB treatment outcomes. Population-based evidence specific to older Chinese PTB-DM patients remains scarce. This retrospective cohort study aimed to identify independent risk factors for adverse treatment outcomes in older Chinese PTB-DM patients. Methods Data were from the National Tuberculosis Information Management System (2018–2024). Kaplan–Meier analysis was performed to estimate overall event-free survival. Fine–Gray competing risks regression models were used to identify independent factors associated with each adverse outcome subtype, accounting for competing events. Results Among 56,682 eligible patients, the median follow-up duration was 6.965 months, and the rate of adverse anti-tuberculosis treatment outcomes was 11.08%. Irregular treatment adherence ( aHR = 12.783, 95%CI : 12.008–13.607), male sex ( aHR = 1.246, 95%CI : 1.176–1.319), increased age ( aHR = 1.345–2.459), retreatment ( aHR = 1.112, 95%CI : 1.031–1.199), positive etiological test results ( aHR = 1.338, 95%CI : 1.259–1.421), comorbidities other than diabetes ( aHR = 1.234, 95%CI : 1.154–1.320), and non-guideline-concordant regimens, ( aHR = 1.096, 95%CI : 1.025–1.171) were independent risk factors for adverse treatment outcomes. Conclusions Adverse treatment outcomes in older adults with PTB-DM are driven by a range of demographic, clinical and adherence-related factors, with irregular medication adherence being the most robust predictor. These risk factors differ across adverse outcome subtypes.

title: The Effect of Extraction Methods of Cassia alata L. Leaves on Flavonoid, Phenolic Contents, and Antifungal Activity
abstractText: Cassia alata L. is used traditionally to treat fungal diseases such as tinea pedis (athlete's foot), caused by Trichophyton rubrum. This study examined how three extraction methods (maceration, reflux, and ultrasonication) applied to C. alata leaves affect total flavonoid content (TFC), total phenolic content (TPC), and antifungal activity. TFC and TPC were determined by UV–Vis spectrophotometry, and antifungal activity was assessed by the well diffusion method. Ultrasonication produced the highest TFC (4.68 mg QE/g), TPC (8.92 mg GAE/g), and antifungal activity (inhibition zone diameter 25.7 mm) compared with maceration and reflux. Ultrasonication was therefore more effective than maceration and reflux at extracting the constituents of C. alata leaves that act against T. rubrum.

Comparative evaluation of thyroid nodule ultrasound segmentation models
abstractText: Abstract Objectives To compare the performance of existing thyroid nodule ultrasound segmentation models and provide evidence for their clinical application. Methods The models were trained and evaluated under standardized conditions on two datasets: the TN5000 public dataset (5,000 images), which was split into training and internal validation sets, and an institutional dataset (1,452 images) used as an independent external test set. Results TNet achieved the best overall performance (external Dice = 0.812), and LGFFM showed higher recall. All models exhibited a consistent and substantial decline in performance over cross-center validation, with non-thyroid-specific models performing worst. Conclusions Existing models have limited cross-center generalizability, and TNet performed best among the evaluated models in this experimental setting, while broader clinical adoption would require prospective multicenter validation. title: Human-AI Communication Symbiosis: How Educators Reconstruct Authority and Identity in the Algorithmic Era
abstractText: The present schooling system is currently facing a dual disruptive crisis, spurred by the encroachment of social media algorithms and generative Artificial Intelligence (AI). While these forces impact the way students learn and think about information, they also induce an epistemological overhaul in the ecology of instructional communication. Students, with their visual rhetorical frameworks from digital platforms and the use of AI for analytical processing, present an apparent disciplinary crisis for their educators-a communication crisis in disguise. Applying Karl Weick's Sensemaking theory, this paper examines school leaders and Guidance Counselors in Samarinda, Indonesia's understanding of these ambiguities and reconceptualization of their roles. Through qualitative case studies based on teachers' pedagogical narratives, this study shows that teachers' epistemological authority is diminishing as they negotiate the hegemonic algorithmic communication. They respond to the students' fear of cognitive degradation by reorienting from a "knowledge transmitting" communicative practice towards "ethical verifiers" and "empathetic listeners." A Human-AI symbiosis is being created with the machine as information provider and humans as ethical validators and empathic listener. Implications were made for the development of policies related to algorithmic communication literacy and the application of tactical empathy in the classroom.

title: KEPRAKTISAN MODEL PEMBELAJARAN SOSIAL EMOSIONAL BERBASIS VIDEO YOUTUBE MINIVILA SEBAGAI MEDIA SCAFFOLDING PADA SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR
abstractText: This study aimed to develop and examine the practicality of a social-emotional learning model based on educational videos from the Minivila YouTube channel as a scaffolding medium for early-grade elementary school students. The study employed a research and development approach adapting the ADDIE model, comprising needs analysis, model design, video product development, expert validation, and limited field trials. The participants involved 10 teachers and 100 early-grade elementary school students selected via purposive sampling. Practicality data were gathered through teacher questionnaires, student questionnaires, and classroom observation sheets, which were subsequently analyzed using descriptive quantitative and qualitative methods. The results revealed that the teacher response reached 94.57% (very practical) and the student response reached 88.78% (very practical). These findings imply that video-based scaffolding guided by a host figure provides a structured, communicative, and practical medium for embedding social-emotional learning in lower elementary classrooms.

abstractText: This research addresses the systemic educational inequality in Thailand, where a severe shortage of physical science laboratories in rural areas hinders the development of 21st-century scientific literacy. Using the ADDIE model, the study developed a virtual world technology innovation, the AR SciLab platform, to serve as a high-quality, risk-free learning infrastructure. The innovation comprises a database of eight career-oriented experiments (e.g., biodiesel production and essential oil extraction), 3D immersive VR environments built on Unreal Engine 5, and bilingual instructional media. Tested with 500 primary and secondary students and 10 teachers across diverse regions, the results showed significant academic improvement, with 70.8% of students achieving a relative gain score of at least 50%. Qualitative data revealed that the metaverse environment effectively bypassed geographical resource gaps and increased student motivation through “learning by doing.” Despite technical challenges such as “VR sickness,” the study demonstrates that virtual labs provide a scalable, equitable solution for marginalized schools, supporting the “Thailand Zero Dropout” initiative by ensuring that a student’s location no longer dictates the quality of their scientific education.
